texts.label: R9967, Venice, 25 Aug 1552
texts.summary: Francisco de Vargas at Venice to Charles V, 25 August 1552: the Pope is suspected of double dealing over Siena (Cardinal Sant'Angelo coming to Venice for France; the legate sent to Siena to take it under papal protection, as the popes took Bologna); the Duke of Florence may be deceived again; the Duke of Urbino's request to Venice for the generalship or leave read as a plan to join France for the Naples enterprise; the conde de Pitigliano's son gone over to France; Serri, a French secretary carrying despatches from Termes to Brissac, to be seized; postscript on the Prince of Salerno's French and Turkish galleys at Porto Ercole.

reading_review.note: Read from the contemporary decipherment written on the letter (left margins, page feet, interlinear; one continuous text across 14 pages), transcribed in full from the DECODE images (texts/R9967_decipherment.txt), with the clear paragraphs from the original. Checked against the cipher where it can be without a key: clear words inside the cipher lines agree word for word, and the code groups ager (cardenal), pollo (papa), s-o, x-o, n-o recur with the same decipherment (texts/R9967_code_check.tsv). b17 on the body 0.701 plain, 0.996 explicit holes. Open: eight words of the marginal hand and the legate's name, illegible at DECODE's resolution.
